text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in the opening sentence","quality":"explicit claim","description":"The essay states a direct position early, making its argument easy to follow from the start."},{"evidence":"three organized body paragraphs","quality":"paragraph organization","description":"The essay develops its case in distinct sections with one main point per paragraph."},{"evidence":"Google cars have 'driven more than half a million miles without a crash'","quality":"textual evidence use","description":"The essay supports claims with specific details from the article rather than relying only on general opinion."},{"evidence":"explains how a driverless car would reduce drunk-driving and human mistakes","quality":"reasoned support","description":"The essay connects evidence to a plausible chain of reasoning instead of just listing benefits."},{"evidence":"discussion of leisure and in-car entertainment","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay extends its argument by developing one point into a fuller consequence for drivers and car makers."},{"evidence":"concluding sentence restates the position and reasons","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by summarizing its main claims and reinforcing the overall argument."}]}
